title: African Diasporas
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Facts (to confirm): W. E. B. Du Bois, Marcus Garvey, George Padmore, Kwame Nkrumah; Pan-African congresses (Manchester 1945).

skills.key_step: The child says what a diaspora is and the factors that put Africans across the world.

floor.prerequisite: Gives the factors of the Indian Ocean slave trade.
floor.question: Give one factor of the Indian Ocean slave trade.
floor.answer: any factor such as plantation demand

board.say: Does it mean the homeland or people living away?

misconceptions.ask: Which factor brought many Africans to the Americas?
misconceptions.repair: Ask whether captives chose to board the ships.

misconceptions.ask: Give a reason Africans live abroad today besides the slave trade.
Which trade took Africans to Arabia and India?
misconceptions.repair: Recall the Indian Ocean routes from the slavery lesson.

checks.question: What is a diaspora?
checks.answer: a people living away from their homeland

skills.key_step: The child places where African diasporas lived by 1960.

floor.question: What is a diaspora?
floor.answer: a people living away from their homeland

board.say: Which island with a large African diaspora is here?

misconceptions.ask: Which region held a large African diaspora by 1960?
misconceptions.repair: Ask which countries are named for the Caribbean.
Ask which ocean lies around Jamaica.
Find Brazil on a world map.

misconceptions.ask: Did African diasporas live in Europe by 1960?
misconceptions.repair: Name the Manchester Pan-African Congress of 1945.

checks.question: Name one country with a large African diaspora by 1960.
checks.answer: any of: the United States, Brazil, Jamaica, Haiti, Cuba, Britain, France

skills.key_step: The child tells how the diasporas helped political change in Africa through Pan-Africanism.

floor.question: Give one harm of colonial rule.
floor.answer: any harm such as loss of independence

board.say: Pan means all. What does Pan-Africanism mean?

misconceptions.ask: How did the diaspora help African independence?

misconceptions.repair: Sort leaders: from the diaspora, from Africa.
Read a short line from a congress resolution.

checks.question: What is Pan-Africanism?
checks.answer: the idea that African peoples should unite

checks.question: How did the diaspora help African independence?
checks.answer: supported Pan-Africanism, congresses and writings for freedom
